text.en: This order may be cited as the Constitution of Universiti Brunei Citation and Darussalam (Amendment) Order, 1989 and shall be deemed to have commencecome into force on the 1st. day of April, 1989. ment.

Section 20(1) of the Constitution is amended -Amendment of section 2011 ).

(c) by deleting the full stop at the end of paragraph (d) and substituting therefor ''; and ''; and

BRUNEI DARUSSALAM GOVERNMENT GAZETTE

(d) by adding the following new paragraph (e) - "(e) Director of Establishment (or his representative)." Made this 13th. day of April, 1989 at Our Istana Nurul Iman, Bandar Seri Begawan, Brunei Darussalam.

HIS MAJESTY

THE SULTAN AND YANG DI-PERTUAN BRUNEI DARUSSALAM.
